strategy_notes: Localized the wine bottle and plate from agentview_high pixels with back_project, then used wrist only to confirm the bottle geometry from the same agentview anchor. Step 1 moved above the bottle at [-0.196,-0.052,1.15] open. Step 2 used pi0_pick with prompt pick up the wine bottle, max_chunks 20, lift_thresh 0.05, gripper_closed_thresh 0.06; visual evidence and gripper opening confirmed the bottle was held. Step 3 firmed the grip with set_gripper +1 for 8 steps. Step 4 carried to [0.05,-0.016,1.12] with gripper +1 and step_clip 0.015. Step 5 lowered to [0.05,-0.016,1.02] with gripper +1 and step_clip 0.01. Step 6 released for 30 steps but did not terminate; the bottle was on the front/edge of the plate. Step 7 reclosed for 5 steps. Step 8 made a short closed-gripper centering nudge to [0.08,-0.005,1.031] with step_clip 0.006. Step 9 released for 40 steps and the predicate terminated true.
